appropriate_uses: Attributable Russian presidential statements, signed presidential documents, formal policy positions, and official event transcripts.
inappropriate_uses: Independent verification of truth, sincerity, legal entitlement, battlefield conditions, military capability, or implementation.
known_failure_modes: Strategic messaging; selective disclosure; retrospective reframing; policy ambiguity; official English editions may smooth distinctions in the Russian original.
name: President of Russia
observables: Russian presidential rhetoric, signed acts, declared policy, negotiation terms, warnings, and denials
originating_chain_rule: Russian and English editions, special.kremlin.ru mirrors, video, transcript, and state-media reproductions of the same presidential event are one lineage.

review_history.note: Admitted by explicit operator choice for bounded primary-position verification; interested-source and edition-lineage limits recorded.
